why: Chris, 3 October 2026: "I want a new channel for programming in pascal and programming in java and one for Ai called AI 4 All. i need logos and brands for youtube for these channels". The logos themselves are drawn as SVG (design board https://claude.ai/artifact/LtgVBNvwsQKPhcxTb9feYz); these pictures are the illustrated alternative avatars and the banner backgrounds the name and logo sit on. Banner rule: YouTube shows only the middle 1546 x 423 of 2560 x 1440 on every device, so the middle must stay calm and dark for the logo and name. Colours per channel: Pascal navy #12355b and teal #2ec4b6; Java coffee brown #2b1a12 and orange #f28c28; AI 4 All indigo #2d2a8c, lilac #c9b8ff and gold #ffd166.
style: No text, no letters, no numbers, no words, no logos anywhere.
